```{r}
samplab.form <- samplabs %>%
  select(Subject.Number, placebo) %>%
  mutate(preP = ifelse(placebo == "Week 0", 1, 3), #quote bc exact string #==; is equal to operator #true = 1, false =3
         postP = ifelse(placebo == "Week 0", 2, 4), 
         preBRB = ifelse(placebo == "Week 0", 3, 1),
        postBRB = ifelse(placebo == "Week 0", 4, 2)) %>%
  pivot_longer(names_to = "timepoint.label", values_to = "timepoints", cols = c("preP", "postP", "preBRB", "postBRB")) %>%
  mutate(Sample = paste0(Subject.Number, "-", timepoints)) %>%
  select(Sample, timepoint.label) 


cyto.form <- cytokines %>%
 select(-X) %>% pivot_wider(names_from = cytokine, values_from = avg.res) %>%
  mutate(Sample = gsub("^0", "", Sample), Sample = gsub("\\.1$", "", Sample)) %>%
  left_join(samplab.form) %>%
  mutate(berry.group = ifelse(grepl("postBRB",timepoint.label), 1, 0))
```

```{r}
object <- c("ALCAM.CD166", "C.Reactive.Protein.CRP", "CCL2.JE.MCP.1", "Complement.Component.C9", "Cystatin.C", "IL.1.beta.IL.1F2", "IL.10", "IL.12.IL.23.p40", "IL.6", "MMP.2", "S100A9", "TNF.alpha", "vWF.A2", "IL.17F")

capture.models.univ <- function(outcome, lfun, cytos, modin) {
  mods.list <- lapply(cytos, function(x)  try({glm(as.formula(paste0(outcome, " ~ ", x)), family = lfun, data = modin) %>% tidy()}))
  
mods.list.clean <- list.clean(mods.list, function(x) is.null(x))
mods.df <- bind_rows(mods.list.clean)
return(mods.df)
}
```


```{r warning=FALSE}
plot <- capture.models.univ(outcome = "berry.group", lfun = "binomial", cytos = object, modin = cyto.form) %>%
  filter(p.value<1.0) %>%
  filter(term !="(Intercept)") %>%
  # mutate(term = fct_reorder(term, estimate)) %>%
  mutate(pointlabs = ifelse(-log(p.value) > 0.5, term, NA)) %>%
  
ggplot(aes(x = estimate, y = -log(p.value), label = pointlabs, color = term)) +
  geom_point() +
  theme_bw(base_size = 18) +
  labs(x = "Estimate", y = "-log(p-value)") 


```

```{r}
plot +
  geom_label_repel() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.5) +
  theme(legend.position="none") +
  # ggtitle("Effect Size of Cytokines in Current and Former Smokers") +
  # theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)) +
  scale_color_viridis_d(option = "turbo")

ggsave("../figures/cytokine_effect-size_volcano-plot.png")
```

```{r}
cyto_prepost <- cyto.form %>%
  filter(timepoint.label %in% c("preBRB", "postBRB"))

#  Extract Subject.Number 
cyto_clean <- cyto_prepost %>%
  mutate(Subject.Number = sub("-.*", "", Sample))

# Pivot longer so cytokines become rows
cyto_long <- cyto_clean %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = ALCAM.CD166:vWF.A2,
    names_to = "cytokine",
    values_to = "value"
  )

# Pivot wider to get pre/post in columns
cyto_wide <- cyto_long %>%
  group_by(Subject.Number, cytokine, timepoint.label) %>%
  summarise(value = mean(as.numeric(value), na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = timepoint.label,
    values_from = value
  ) %>%
  mutate(change = postBRB - preBRB)


# Optional — wide matrix for heatmap
cyto_heat_matrix <- cyto_wide %>%
  select(Subject.Number, cytokine, change) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = cytokine, values_from = change) %>%
  column_to_rownames("Subject.Number") %>%
  as.matrix()

# Heatmap
pheatmap::pheatmap(
  cyto_heat_matrix,
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_cols = TRUE,
  color = colorRampPalette(c("blue", "white", "red"))(100),
  main = "Cytokine Change (PostBRB - PreBRB)",
  fontsize_row = 5

)


```

```{r}
compliance_cluster_df <- as.data.frame(compliance_cluster_df)

common_ids <- intersect(rownames(cyto_heat_matrix), rownames(compliance_cluster_df))

cyto_heat_matrix1 <- cyto_heat_matrix[common_ids, ]
annotation_df <- compliance_cluster_df[common_ids, , drop = FALSE]

pheatmap::pheatmap(
  cyto_heat_matrix1,
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_cols = TRUE,
  color = colorRampPalette(c("blue", "white", "red"))(100),
  main = "Cytokine Change (PostBRB - PreBRB)",
  fontsize_row = 7
)

```
```{r}
cyto_heat <- cyto_wide %>%
  select(Subject.Number, cytokine, change) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = cytokine, values_from = change) %>%
  column_to_rownames("Subject.Number") %>%
  as.matrix()
# Match only participants in both datasets:
common_ids <- intersect(rownames(cyto_heat), rownames(compliance_cluster_df))
cyto_heat_matched <- cyto_heat[common_ids, ]
annotation_df <- compliance_cluster_df[common_ids, , drop = FALSE]

annotation_colors <- list(
  BRB_response = c("Responder" = "skyblue", "Non-responder" = "gold")
)

P<- pheatmap(
  cyto_heat_matched,
  annotation_row = annotation_df,
  annotation_colors = annotation_colors,
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_cols = TRUE,
  color = colorRampPalette(c("blue", "white", "red"))(100),
  fontsize_row = 7

)
ggsave("cytokine_heatmap_by BRB response.png",, width = 8, height = 6)


```
```{r}
# Subset to only responders
responder_ids <- rownames(annotation_df)[annotation_df$BRB_response == "Responder"]

cyto_heat_responders <- cyto_heat_matched[responder_ids, ]
annotation_responders <- annotation_df[responder_ids, , drop = FALSE]

# Plot heatmap for responders only
pheatmap(
  cyto_heat_responders,
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_cols = TRUE,
  color = colorRampPalette(c("blue", "white", "red"))(100),
  fontsize_row = 7)

```
